title: Alto and tenor clefs
description: The C clef on its two common lines: alto (staffPosition 0, middle line) in bar 1 and tenor (staffPosition 2, fourth line) in bar 2, the same four pitches under each so the shift is visible. Middle C sits on the clef's line in both bars. Pins the C clef's glyph and its pitch placement — before core-measure-attributes-gaps.md a C clef drew as a treble clef and placed every pitch a sixth wrong, and no scenario said so.
